entries.title: boot.log: a kidnapped workstation
entries.summary: How a work PC got kidnapped twice before reaching the office, why I'm doing this at all, and the toolchain I set up in the two weeks before the jam.
entries.cover_alt: Pixel art: a woman in walking boots carries a PC tower away from an office building at night, a small green dragon flying beside her

entries.title: validate.sh: the night before, and a Director's Cut
entries.summary: One long day of testing everything twice, an agent that went one step too far, deleting it all, the kickoff stream and the theme.
entries.cover_alt: Pixel art: a desk at night with a PC tower and a laptop joined by a cable, a film clapperboard, and a small green dragon asleep on the tower

entries.title: push_pull.md: inspiration, not a plan
entries.summary: There is no concept yet. There is a pile of directions pulling against each other, and me being overwhelmed at 3 AM, three hours before the start.
entries.cover_alt: Pixel art: a woman with a small dragon on her shoulder at a forest fork at night, paths to a castle, a lit house and a golden trophy

entries.title: day-1.log: build the smallest world
entries.summary: At 06:00 there was no game. Eighteen hours later there was a tested UE 5.8 build ladder, an island, NPCs, time and weather, and an honest list of what was still broken.
entries.cover_alt: Split image with the early UE third-person template movement test on the left and the first populated jam island iteration on the right

entries.title: day-2.log: builds, overload and one decision board
entries.summary: Five more packaged builds turned the prototype into a dense playable system. Day 2 also became a test of how to decide when agents, branches and boards move faster than one person can read.
entries.cover_alt: Three-part view of the Day 2 prototype world, a film-print look comparison and the expanding castle approach

entries.title: day-3.log
entries.summary: Build 1 starts. An escort, a cell with two cellmates who talk back through NVIDIA ACE, a kit-built castle and end credits. Then two GPU driver hangs, a hard reboot and a new way of working.

entries.title: day-4.log
entries.summary: One compile line, clothes on everyone, Shipping builds, a live playtest with 120 notes, and the submission.

entries.title: post-mortem.log
entries.summary: What four days of solo jamming with a crowd of AI agents produced, what was cut, and what I would change.

entries.title: builds.log
entries.summary: Every build of the jam so far, with the branches, features and fixes that went into it.

entries.title: whoami
entries.summary: I research virtual production at Filmuniversität Babelsberg KONRAD WOLF, I trained as an interior designer, and I keep asking what AI does to the making of worlds.
